outcome: Child Behavior Checklist syndrome scores (behavioral characteristics)
positive screen for autism spectrum disorder (ASD) risk
cohort: The study included 587 children from a multi-center study who were born less than 30 weeks postmenstrual age.
finding: The study identified four discrete neurodevelopmental profiles at age 2, indicating distinct combinations of developmental and behavioral outcomes, with 27.3% of the cohort showing Bayley scores outside the normal range and 11% presenting with elevated behavioral problems.
